items.optimize_reason: 2-day explicit holding window via trade_when. Intraday post-news overreaction begins reverting on Day 1 (Delay 1 entry) and continues through Day 2. Exiting after 2 days captures the sharpest initial mean-reversion phase while cutting turnover by ~50% from 114% to ~57%.

3-day explicit holding window via trade_when. The median institutional liquidity rebalancing window for post-earnings/news overreaction is 3 trading days. A 3-day holding period reduces rebalancing turnover to ~38%, well below the 70% threshold, while preserving multi-day mean-reversion profits.
4-day explicit holding window via trade_when. Captures the full weekly cycle of post-news liquidation. Expected turnover ~28%, scaling Margin to > 5 bps and lifting Fitness above 1.0.
5-day explicit holding window via trade_when. 1 full trading week holding horizon. Completely eliminates churn, targeting turnover ~22% and maximizing Sharpe stability across market regimes.

Signal-level backfill for 3 days. Instead of freezing discrete positions, backfilling the raw drift ratio for 3 days allows the cross-sectional rank to dynamically compare newly arriving news events against events from the past 3 days. Stocks with fresher, larger overreactions naturally outrank older ones.

Signal-level backfill for 5 days. 5-day continuous cross-sectional news surface. Compares all news events occurring within a rolling 5-day window, maintaining continuous portfolio coverage without stale noise from ancient events.

Linear decaying conviction on 5-day backfill. Recent news overreactions have stronger mean-reverting velocity than older ones. Applying ts_decay_linear(..., 5) weights Day 1 at 5/15, Day 2 at 4/15, Day 3 at 3/15, Day 4 at 2/15, Day 5 at 1/15, smoothly exiting positions without abrupt turnover spikes.

Within-industry cross-sectional ranking on 5-day backfill. Sector-level macroeconomic headlines cause synchronous intraday price moves across an entire industry. Evaluating overreaction within each industry isolates idiosyncratic mispricings, insulating the alpha from macro factor risk and passing CLUSTER_TEST.
